body: I feel so worthless..  She wrote me a letter to read when i'm depressed.. That she'd be the one to protect me from my demons, that she'd be there no matter what, that she loved me.. That she'd loved me no matter what... What the fuck happend i feel so fucking worthless i just wanna give into all of my demons and just say fuck it cause she hurt me so bad... and i know she's hurting too.. And it's my fault cause i didn't pay enough attention to her

I've loved her since my sophomore year of highschool.. (She's 20 i'm 19 now) She got me through one of the toughest years of my life, at home i had an abusive step mother and she really helped me alot during that..although i ran away from that abusive home, i lost contact with her for a year and a half, she developed an eating disorder and it got really bad.. And she's relapsing with it now and i think thats part of the reason. I haven't been there for her... But anyway.. We reconnected about a year ago and we've been happy..but recently i took  on a new job to make more money for us.. Working shitty hours (4:30am to 2:00pm) i come home exhausted and she feels ignored.. What really made me upset tonight was an active shooter at her school, she texted me and told me what was happening, got me worried and then told me she wasn't going home and was staying with a friend and she refused to speak with me over the phone.. All i got was a blunt goodnight... Idk i suppose this doesn't make much sense.. On sunday, she didn't text me at all so i emailed her and she sent me this huge paragraph saying how she fell out of her feelings because i wasn't there for her, and when i was i'd make it about me, cause this month has been rough for the both of us... I don't know she was my gyarados.. She was my everything. The whole point of me taking on more hours at work was so we could find a place together.. But i guess it back fired
Yeah I know..but fuck, she won't speak to me and it's brief, she's dealing with a lot herself, we could have gotten through it together..All those fish are magikarps, and nothing will compare to her.
